key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week on rate-rise fears and oil price surge, signalling sharp risk-off rotation
AUD smashed as growth scare builds, pressuring importers and foreign-currency-denominated earnings
Iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase, directly threatening BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX earnings
Oil price explosion (price suppression failure) lifts fuel costs 30c/L, squeezing consumer and transport margins
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate-cut path and pressuring REITs
ANZ.AX axed 3,500 jobs in restructuring; long runway to profitability remains
Mining cap-raise dash led by Canaccord signals sector liquidity stress; Kalgoorlie Super Pit fire adds safety overhang
Housing prices crashing but first-home-buyer surge offers partial offset; no spring bounce in auctions
Santos preservation deemed a national sacrifice, raising energy-sector policy risk
Gold underperforming ('schmould'), reducing safe-haven bid despite macro stress

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active bloodletting; cap-raise frenzy signals cash-flow stress; Kalgoorlie fire adds operational risk; gold underperforming
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression; small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources) volatile; Canaccord-led raises dilute shareholders

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring (3,500 cuts) signals industry-wide cost pressure; RBA rental-inflation focus delays rate cuts, compressing NIM expectations
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face slower credit growth; superannuation policy debate (populism risk) could alter fund flows

sectors.trend: Oil spike lifts input costs; Santos preservation raises policy-intervention risk; fuel prices +30c/L hit downstream margins
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, SSO.AX benefit from oil upside but face policy overhang; BRL.AX, AWE.AX squeezed by fuel cost pass-through

sectors.trend: Woolworths price-freeze breach erodes trust; rising fuel and input costs pressure household budgets; business confidence deteriorating
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX margin pressure; defensive rotation into staples likely but growth limited

sectors.trend: RBA rental-inflation concern; housing price crash with first-home-buyer surge; no auction bounce; social rental build in Perth
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed occupancy vs. yield pressure; construction names (WBC-linked) see modest tailwind

sectors.trend: AI development slowdown calls; Meta ad-revenue surge; data-centre capex (Equinix, Corning) accelerating; Palantir +50% in August
sectors.implications: ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global AI capex but face valuation risk if AI pace slows

key_themes: Rate-rise fears vs. growth scare: RBA caught between rental inflation and slowing activity
Commodity super-cycle reversal: iron ore bloodletting + gold underperformance
Energy shock: oil spike, fuel price rise, Santos policy risk
AUD weakness as growth scare accelerates capital outflows
Mining sector liquidity stress: cap raises, safety incidents
Housing correction: prices falling, buyer surge, no auction recovery
Superannuation policy risk: populism vs. system integrity debate
Global AI capex vs. AI slowdown calls creating tech volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into rate hike or hold amid rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight financials with strong NIM; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold or energy hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil spike driving input-cost inflation and consumer squeeze
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour energy producers (WDS.AX, SSO.AX); avoid transport (QAN.AX) and consumer discretionary
Hedge foreign-currency exposure; favour domestic-revenue ASX names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining cap-raise dilution and safety incidents
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid small-cap miners in cap-raise mode; monitor Kalgoorlie incident fallout for BHP.AX
Monitor political risk; super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) could face regulatory shifts

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil price explosion and 30c fuel rise lift upstream margins; Santos policy risk is a one-off

opportunities.recommendation: Selective mining small-cap exposure on cap-raise recovery
opportunities.rationale: PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources showing momentum post-raise; Iondrive, Aruma, Neurizon on ASX runners list
Equinix, Corning, Palantir momentum; ASX tech (W1.AX) benefits from cloud spend despite AI slowdown calls

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and gold exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting active; gold underperforming; dual commodity weakness rare and signals broad risk-off

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate-risk via defensive staples
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smash + RBA rental-inflation focus; WES.AX/WOW.AX offer relative stability despite margin pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight REITs pending RBA rental-inflation guidance
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA concern over rental inflation could trigger policy tightening; housing crash limits occupancy upside

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate lower as $90bn weekly loss digests; oil spike and AUD weakness create headwinds. RBA rental-inflation commentary may trigger further rate-hike pricing. Iron ore weakness caps materials. Expect 3–5% further downside on ^AXJO before stabilisation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious: housing correction continues but first-home-buyer surge provides floor; ANZ restructuring and bank cost cuts support financials by 2027; AI capex cycle supports tech; iron ore recovery uncertain. Superannuation policy risk is a tail risk. Net: neutral-to-slightly-negative.
